item.title: Sancheong-gun, Gyeongsangnam-do
item.audioTitle: Sancheong-gun, Gyeongsangnam-do - Healing with Oriental Medicine and Nature
item.script: Sancheong-gun, Gyeongsangnam-do - Healing with Oriental Medicine and Nature    Sancheong has a magnificent landscape that includes the popular Jirisan Mountain, and is full of various tourist destinations and interesting stories. In the valley at the foot of Jirisan Mountain is the picturesque Daewonsa Temple. You can also find Namsa Yedamchon Village, in Sancheong which was designated as “the most beautiful village in Korea.”  Sancheong is called the “region of medicinal herbs” as countless medicinal herbs are found in its untainted natural environment. Sancheong successfully hosted the 2013 World Traditional Medicine Expo and the Sancheong Medicinal Herb Festival is held every year. You can see exhibitions related to oriental medicine in Donguibogam Village, where the Korean Medicine Museum and Experiential Themed Park are located.  Sancheong also has many significant sites of historical figures. There is the stone tomb of King Guhyeong, the last king of Gaya, and the remains of Jo Sik (penname: Nammyeong), who, along with Yi Hwang (penname: Toegye), are representative Confucian scholars from the mid-Joseon Dynasty. You should not miss the birthplace of the great Buddhist monk Seong Cheol who is famous for the saying, “mountains are mountains, and rivers are rivers.” Sancheong, in which nature, history and traditional culture harmonize, is an interesting tourist destination for everyone.
